_doc: One source for the four chat menus (owner 2026-11-21): the names on the buttons and the grid. lib/line/rich-menu.ts turns it into what LINE needs; scripts/generate-rich-menu-images.mjs draws the picture from the same file, so the picture and the buttons can never disagree. Only buttons whose function exists are listed: customer 'my rentals / return dates / my documents' and staff / driver 'my jobs / report a problem / history' are not built yet (phase 5) and so are not here.
